digest.headline: Telus cuts dividend and halts acquisitions under new management
digest.lead: Canadian telecommunications operator Telus is cutting its dividend and pausing acquisitions to manage its debt. The company is resetting its strategy under new management.

glance.text: Canadian telecom firm Telus is pausing acquisitions and cutting its dividend to reduce its debt levels.
Industry expert Tom Webster has identified the best real estate to own for growing a podcast.
Audio streaming giant Spotify owns four of the top twenty highest-paid podcasters.

paragraphs: Canadian telecom company Telus is resetting its dividend and pausing acquisitions. The firm is taking these steps under new management to get its debt level in check.
The corporation will issue a new quarterly dividend starting in October. This refocus represents a major shift in the company's financial strategy.
Spotify now owns four of the top twenty highest-paid podcasters in the industry. This concentration highlights the platform's dominant position in the audio market.
Meanwhile, researcher Tom Webster has detailed the most valuable real estate for creators looking to grow their podcasts. Securing this space remains critical for audience expansion.

coming_up.text: Telus will start issuing its reset quarterly dividend
